ops.markdown:
- **QVS stays the system of record.** Engines mirror and derive; writes back are narrow and user-directed.
- **qvs.duckdb has one writer.** Everyone else reads it read-only and backs off when busy.
- **All Google access goes through Google_Connect.** Apps Script bridges are a fallback until Phase 5.
- **Automated sources are read where they land.** Ingest_Automation publishes; consumers do not change it.
- **LLM only classifies and extracts.** Math, joins, matching and state are deterministic Python.
- **Everything runs locally** on Windows Task Scheduler; a missed run catches up at the next wake.
- **Each project draws its own blueprint.** Map mounts them and never writes them.
